observations.text: Skills are packaged multi-step workflows (e.g. 山音编剧大师2.0【Seko独家】 '从一句想法出发,完成全格式影视剧本创作', 26039 uses; 角色概念板 '多视图、装备拆解…表情九宫'; 清宫宫斗剧 '剧本、定妆照、场景与连续视频'). Categories span script planning, art assets, ads, short drama.
The same skill names appear in the canvas agent's / picker and in the home 创作 Agent chips, so skills are invoked through the agent composer.
